skill_name: Design a KB-QA system for an online travel website
workflow: A Knowledge-Based Question Answering (KB-QA) system for an online travel website can be created by creating a Knowledge Base (KB) containing information related to the website and its services. For example, the KB can contain information about destinations, attractions, hotels, flights, packages, deals and more. The KB-QA system can then use natural language processing (NLP) techniques such as entity recognition, part-of-speech tagging, and semantic parsing, to identify entities and key phrases
